dispositions.rationale: Admission happens only when the developer republishes a new, locally validated head through finish. A review/repair/finalization claim is head-bound: the accepted BR-353 worker contract (bounded-worker-contract child) requires a job result for a different head to be discarded and re-evaluated for the current head, so the old-head claim is stale by definition and must not veto the new admission. Review round 8 required exactly this (old-head lifecycle must not block re-admission of a freshly validated head); keeping the claim would reintroduce that defect. Cross-head claims are still honoured for coordinator branch updates, which change the head without new task content.
